'''1998 Jabba's Palace Pre-Release (Mountain View)''' was a [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] pre-release tournament on 25 April 1998 at Match Play in Mountain View, California. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] (Red 32) was the tournament director.<ref name="pre">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/pre.html Jabba's Pre-release], Paul Todd Feldman. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022042653/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/pre.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==
* '''Type:''' Pre-release
* '''Date:''' 25 April 1998, 12:00 PM
* '''Site:''' Match Play, Mountain View, California
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
